Thus first two area-weighted moments are Σ A_i^k I_k,i/(2π); Cauchy brightness and the Gaussian absolute-moment kernel yield unconditional first and second moments and quadrilateral complements. All formulas hold for any nondegenerate tetrahedron and Haar-uniform directions.
